chapter.verse: Bittak ka suahtak khit uh ciangin tua tuikulh Malta kici ahihlam ka theikha uh hi.
Guahzuk kipan khinin khuadam ahih manin tualsung mite in meiphual cihin ka vekun hong muak uh a, lamet ngamloh zahin mihing kikhualna hong lak uh hi.
Paul in singkang lom khat khawmin meiphual ah a khul leh mei satna hangin mualtan khat hong taikhia-in Paul' khut ah kivial hi.

Paul' khut tunga kivial tua gamsa a muh uh ciangin tualsung mite khatlekhat kiho uh a, “Hih mipa tualthat khat hi hamtang ding hi. Tuipi pan hong suahtak hangin Dike in amah a nuntak ding phal lo hi,” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Paul in mei sungah tua gamsa singkhia a, thusia bangmah tuak lo hi.

Tualsung mite in Paul a ci a bawk ding hun, ahihkeileh thaltukin a sih ding hun ngak uh hi. Ahih hangin sawtpi ngak napi uh Paul' tungah a namtuam deuh bangmah piang lo cih a muh uh ciangin a lungsim uh khelin Paul pen pasian khat hi ci uh hi.
Tu-in tua mun kiimlepam teng pen Publius minnei tuikulh ukpipa' leitang vive ahi hi. Ukpipa in vaipuak hong la-in ni thum sung nekngaihna tak tawh zin hong do hi.
Publius a pa cisanat leh gilsan ngahin ngap lo-in lum hi. Paul in va vehin thungen a, ama' tungah khut nga-in damsak hi.
Hih thu a pian ciangin tuikulh tunga natna nei dang a omlaite zong hong pai uh a, damna ngah uh hi.
Amau zong zahtakna lianpi tawh kote hong thupibawl uh a, ka zinkhiat ding uh ciangin ka kitangsap teng uh tembaw tungah hong guan uh hi.
Kha thum khit ciangin tua tuikulh ah phalbi sung a khawl, ciaptehna milim dingin Vantung Unau Peng a suang, Alexandria tembaw khat tawh khualzin ka zom uh hi.
Syracuse khua ah khawlin tua takah ni thum ka taam uh hi.
Tua tak pan kualpai-in Rhegium ka tung uh hi. Ni khat khit ciangin leitawlam pan huih hong kipanto a, a ni nihni-in Puteoli ka tung uh hi.
Tua takah sanggamte tawh ka kimu uh a, ni sagih sung a taam dingin hong kho uh hi. Tua bang teng tawh Rome khua ka tung uh hi.

Ka tun uh a zak ciangun tua taka om sanggamte, ko tawh kimu dingin Appius Sumbukphual leh Zinbuk Ansai Thumkop ciangdong hong pai uh hi. Paul in amaute a muh ciangin Pasian phat a, a lungsim thadimtuam hi.
Rome khuapi sung ka tun uh ciangin Paul pen galkap khat' cinna tawh amah kia omtheih ding phalna kipia hi.

Ni thum khit ciangin Paul in Jew mi tualsung makaite samkhawm a, hong kikhop uh ciangin amaute' kiangah, “Sanggamte aw, i mipihte leh i pupite' ngeina zatziate langpangin ka sep bangmah om lo napi Jerusalem panin thongkia mi khat bangin Rome mite' khutsung hong ki-ap hi.
Rome mite in kei hong dottel khit uh ciangin kei' vai ah sihna tuah nading thu om lo ahih manin kei hong khahkhia nuam uh hi.
Hinapi, Jew mite in a nial uh ciangin—ka mipihte ka mawhsak nading a om loh hangin—Caesar' kiangah thumbehna ka puaktoh hong kul hi.
Tua hi a, hih bangin kolbulh ka thuakna pen Israel mite' neih lametna thu hang ahih manin hih thu hangin note tawh kimu kiho dingin hong samsak ka hi hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, “Nang tawh kisai thu Judea gam pan laikhak ka ngah uh om lo a, hih tak hong pai sanggamte khat beek in zong nang tawh kisai thusia hong koh uh, thu a ginsak uh, om lo hi.
Ahi zongin hih pawlke tawh kisai-in mun citeng ah kigensia cih thei ka hih manun nang'n bangci muh cih nang' kiangpan ka za nuam uh hi,” ci uh hi.

Paul tawh kimuh ding ni khat a seh khit uh ciangin amaute tampitak Paul' giahna zintunna inndei ah hong pai uh hi. Paul in zingsang-a kipan nitak dong amaute' tungah thu gentel a, Moses' Thukhun Laibu leh Kamsang Laibuh siksanin Pasian' kumpigam thu khauhtakin teci pangin Jesu' thu a san theih nadingun hanciam hi.
Kimkhat in Paul' thugente sangthei uh a, himah taleh kimkhat in um lo uh hi.

Amau' teng kithutuak lo uh ahih manin Paul in thuphuanna khat a neih khit ciangin amaute kikhen uh hi. Paul' thuphuanna hih bang hi: “Kha Siangtho in na pupite uh' kiangah kamsang Isaiah' tungtawnin a gen thu pen maan hi:
“‘Hih mite' kiangah va pai inla, "Zaza napi-in na tel ngeikei ding uh a, en-en napi-in na mu ngeikei ding uh hi," ci-in gen in.

A hang pen hih mite a lungsim uh khingdang khin a, a bilte un khuaza mengmeng nawnlo-in a mitte uh zong si khinta uh hi. Tua hikeileh a mit uh tawh mukha-in a bil uh tawh zakha-in a lungsim sung uhah zong telkha-in hong kiheikha ding uh a, tua hileh amaute ka damsak a kul ding ahi hi.’
Tua ahih manin hih Pasian' hotkhiatna thu Gentile mite' kiangah kipuak khinta a, amau zong na sang ding uh, cih thu thei ta un.”
Rome khuapi ah Paul kum nih bit taam a, ama' innsapna mah ah om hi. Ama' kiang a zuan khempeuh dawntuah a,
hangtak leh suaktatak Pasian' kumpigam thu tangko-in Topa Jesu Khris' thu hilhcian hi.
